Documentation / Infrastructure

Build for the unexpected.

Reliable systems continue working when individual components fail. Good architecture makes recovery predictable.

Disaster recovery

Use DR to recover from a regional failure. Do not disable replication. Retain at least 3 replicas.

A second DR plan protects customer records when the primary region is unavailable.

The API connects independent applications through an explicit contract. Read the next section.

Daily operations

The DR job runs every morning at 08:00. Here DR stands for daily run, not disaster recovery.
